newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower on slow pay demand.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower on slow pay demand.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed lower on Monday due to slower-than-expected payroll demand for the early month period, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.847 percent against Saturday's 4.956 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 4.75-4.80 against 4.85-4.90.
Dealers expected the rates to stabilise on Tuesday on rising demand for liquidity before the October 10 national holiday.
In the bond market, the 15-year (0442) construction bond yield was at 5.9670-9700 against 5.9800 and the 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 5.64750-6500. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
